halfLife.notes: Very short half-life. Twice- or thrice-daily dosing typical. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Reversible, selective MAO-A inhibition — fundamentally different from irreversible MAOIs (phenelzine, tranylcypromine). Clearance time after stopping moclobemide is ~24h, vs 14 days for irreversible MAOIs. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

maoiWashout.notes: Switching FROM moclobemide TO another serotonergic: ~24h washout typical due to reversibility. FROM an irreversible MAOI to moclobemide: standard 14 days. The engine's MAOI hard-block uses these values. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

discontinuationSyndromeRisk.notes: Low discontinuation risk due to short half-life and reversible mechanism. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Tablets available. Generally tyramine-safe at therapeutic doses but counsel patients to take after meals and avoid very high-tyramine foods. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
